Brazil Presidential Election Heads to Run-off

Brazil's presidential election is heading to a run-off between incumbent Jair Bolsonaro and former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Early vote counts showed Bolsonaro leading Lula, but neither candidate secured enough votes to win outright in the first round. The election results indicate a close contest between the two frontrunners.
